title: Guinea's President Lansana Conte, known for his decisive leadership, has mobilized a 10,000-strong elite force in response to threats from Sierra Leone's Revolutionary United Front (RUF). This move aims to counter potential rebel incursions and address internal dissidence, particularly following the detention of Guinean dissidents fighting alongside the RUF. Despite facing growing discontent due to urban development projects leading to displacement and riots, Conte's government is focused on maintaining security and showcasing achievements ahead of elections. Meanwhile, the Kamajors, a local militia, face challenges due to the commercialization of their initiation process, leading to a rise in fake initiators and a decline in their mystical powers. Many Kamajors are now looking to return to farming but seek government support, which is currently lacking.
